concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-oauth-node]] - Node.js OAuth access-revocation notification for connected merchants, with production closed-beta and sandbox open-beta qualifications plus payload and parsing routes
warnings: Preserve the availability split exactly: closed beta in production and open beta in sandbox.
Keep the event scoped to a connected merchant revoking API access; do not infer other OAuth notification kinds.
The callback and Promise code parses a received notification; it does not perform access revocation or trigger webhook delivery.
Do not generalize the examples' `Sandbox` gateway configuration into a sandbox-only claim, and do not import behavior from the unread OAuth or parsing guides.
